verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Typesense is open source (GPL-3.0), can be self-hosted, and runs the same engine in Cloud, which lowers lock-in. It also describes pushing CSV/JSON data into Typesense. None of the evidence documents exporting all data out of Typesense in open formats, so the open-source and self-host claims are adjacent to the story rather than delivering it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
